name: 财务会计中的组织灵活性 (4PG)
description_en_html:
Overview

A management decision triggers a change to the profit center structure.

The current scope supports profit center reassignment for WBS elements and project headers, products (materials), orders, cost centers, and fixed assets. It also includes corresponding sales and purchase documents as well as production orders and product cost collectors. You can define the profit center reassignment for the designated master data and business objects. The objects affected by the reorganization are reassigned and their balances are reposted to the new organizational entities.

You can define the profit center reassignment for the designated master data and business objects. The objects affected by the reorganization are reassigned and their balances are reposted to the new organizational entities.

The solution supports the reassignment of profit centers at a key date (effective date).

The solution offers the simulation of an organizational change. Analytics capabilities are provided for the assessment of the completeness of the object list and the profit center reassignment status, preview or review of the transfer posting and its effect on financial KPIs, and log checking for the steps performed.

Key Process Flow

  • Create organizational change
  • Identify objects affected by an organizational change
  • Assign objects – List views
  • Simulate an organizational change
  • Analyze the impact on master data and profit center balances
  • Activate the organizational change
  • Process the organizational change
  • Complete the organizational change

Business Benefits

  • Conduct organizational structure change flexibly in the profit center (financial accounting organization entity)
  • Reduce finance cost by supporting an organization's ability to perform changes in a timely manner
  • Automate master data update and account balance postings to reduce manual workload and ensure greater accuracy
  • React easily and quickly to changed internal and external situations
  • Adjust the internal controlling structure and the external reporting structure with effectiveness and efficiency
description_zh_html:
概览

管理决策会触发对利润中心结构的更改。

当前范围支持 WBS 要素和项目抬头、产品（物料）、订单、成本中心和固定资产的利润中心重新分配。还包括相应的销售和采购凭证以及生产订单和产品成本收集器。您可以为指定的主数据和业务对象定义利润中心重新分配。将重新分配受重组影响的对象，并将其余额重新过账到新的组织实体。

您可以为指定的主数据和业务对象定义利润中心重新分配。将重新分配受重组影响的对象，并将其余额重新过账到新的组织实体。

该解决方案支持在关键日期（生效日期）重新分配利润中心。

解决方案提供组织更改的模拟。提供分析功能用于评估对象清单的完整性和利润中心重新分配状态、预览或审核传输过账及其对财务 KPI 的影响以及已执行步骤的日志检查。

关键流程流

  • 创建组织变更
  • 识别受组织更改影响的对象
  • 分配对象 - 清单视图
  • 模拟组织变更
  • 分析对主数据和利润中心余额的影响。
  • 激活组织更改
  • 处理 组织更改
  • 完成组织更改

业务优势

  • 在利润中心（财务会计组织实体）中灵活执行组织结构更改
  • 通过支持组织及时执行变更，降低财务成本
  • 自动化主数据更新和科目余额过账，以减少手动工作量并确保更高的准确性
  • 轻松、快速地应对不断变化的内部和外部情况
  • 根据有效性和效率，调整内部控制结构和外部报告结构
